appName: London: Changing of the Guard Experience – VR Travel
displayName: London: Changing of the Guard Experience – VR Travel
display_name: London: Changing of the Guard Experience – VR Travel
display_long_description:
Each year, millions of tourists gather at Buckingham Palace to witness the iconic Changing of the Guard. This ceremonial display of British discipline has been attracting visitors since 1689, making it a must-see event in London. Now, with our VR experience, you can skip the crowds and get an exclusive, up-close view from a vantage point few can access.

Feel as if you’re sticking your head behind the palace railings, while tourists stand crowded in front, trying to catch a glimpse. You, however, get a clear view of the guards marching, accompanied by traditional military music. Immerse yourself in the authentic sounds—the clicking of boots, drumbeats, and the bustle of the crowd. Experience this exclusive perspective, impossible in real life.

After the ceremony, take a virtual walk around Buckingham Palace. Picture yourself walking the same paths where royals have strolled for centuries, with street performers and the buzz of London life around you. This 75-minute VR experience offers the perfect escape, letting you leave your routine behind and enjoy British history and culture. It’s like a quick day trip—step away, clear your mind, and enjoy a peaceful moment in an iconic setting.

Step into a world of British tradition, enjoy the ceremony from an exclusive view, and experience the Changing of the Guard like never before—where you're not just watching history, but living it.
